# Day 2: Data Import and Manipulation {#sec-day2}

## Learning objectives

By the end of this day you should be able to:

- Read a CSV or Excel file into R as a tibble.
- Distinguish a tibble from a base-R data frame and know
  when the difference matters.
- Apply the six core `dplyr` verbs: `filter`, `select`,
  `mutate`, `summarise`, `arrange`, `group_by`.
- Chain operations using the native pipe `|>`.
- Join two tables on a shared key (`left_join`,
  `inner_join`).
